test_title: PYST 39: SSC GD Constable 2024 - English (Held On: 01 Mar, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate word to fill in the blank.

Are you ________ aware of what may happen?
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**fully**" correctly completes the sentence to convey that someone is completely aware of what may happen.
 
• The other options do not fit grammatically or contextually in the sentence.
 
• Option 2) "freely" does not make sense in this context.
 
• Option 3) "firm" does not fit grammatically in this context.
 
• Option 4) "full" does not grammatically fit in the context.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Are you** fully** aware of what may happen?"*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **fully:** completely or entirely; to the fullest extent.
 
• **freely:** without restriction or interference.
 
• **firm:** having a solid, almost unyielding surface or structure.
 
• **full:** containing or holding as much or as many as possible; having no empty space.
